hook.rumour: Every copper coin tossed into the Lucky Old Lady's fountain in Bravil vanishes before dawn, replaced by stamped brass tokens that only the midnight skooma-barges accept.
hook.notice: CHAPEL OF MARA & BRAVIL CANAL WATCH: Seeking an honest blade to investigate the night-tampering at the Lucky Old Lady plaza and Lunar Fang Docks.

stages.objective: Keep watch over the Lucky Old Lady statue in Bravil and collect the stamped brass tokens
Follow the token-runner along the canal boardwalk to Lunar Fang Docks
Show the harbour-stamp impression to Sister-Almoner Viera at the Bravil Chapel

objectives.text: Keep watch over the Lucky Old Lady statue in Bravil and collect the stamped brass tokens

Show the harbour-stamp impression to Sister-Almoner Viera at the Bravil Chapel

consequence_detail.summary: The brass tokens in the fountain are struck with the private customs die of Bravil's senior harbour clerk.

stages.objective: Track the night-barge couriers north from Bravil along the Green Road
Search the courier's saddlebags at the Inn of Ill Omen for the river-lock schedule
Question the retired lock-keeper at Faregyl Inn about Clerk Petronius's hidden cistern

objectives.text: Track the night-barge couriers north from Bravil along the Green Road
Search the courier's saddlebags at the Inn of Ill Omen for the river-lock schedule
Question the retired lock-keeper at Faregyl Inn about Clerk Petronius's hidden cistern

consequence_detail.summary: The lock-keeper reveals that an old brick customs cistern directly under the Lucky Old Lady plaza is opened by a bronze key kept at Fort Aurus.

stages.objective: Cross the Niben valley east from Faregyl Inn toward Fort Aurus
Defeat the river-syndicate guards at Fort Aurus and recover the bronze cistern key
Carry the bronze key back to the Lucky Old Lady plaza in Bravil

objectives.text: Cross the Niben valley east from Faregyl Inn toward Fort Aurus
Defeat the river-syndicate guards at Fort Aurus and recover the bronze cistern key

consequence_detail.summary: With the bronze key from Fort Aurus, the secret customs vault beneath the Lucky Old Lady can be unlocked.

stages.objective: Bring the Fort Aurus tariff rolls downriver to Bravil
Unlock the plaza cistern beneath the Lucky Old Lady and defeat Clerk Petronius's syndicate guard
Distribute the recovered customs chest to the Chapel of Mara's canal-alms house in Bravil

objectives.text: Bring the Fort Aurus tariff rolls downriver to Bravil
Unlock the plaza cistern beneath the Lucky Old Lady and defeat Clerk Petronius's syndicate guard

consequence_detail.summary: Clerk Petronius and his Council of Ash paymaster are arrested beneath the plaza, and the stolen river-tariffs fund Bravil's canal repairs.
